## The detection screen finally has personality

ALERT used to just be text and a border. Now it glitches on purpose: a headline that jitters and tears, TV-static snow, and it all escalates the longer a detection stays up -- calm at first, a full-screen pixel tear joining in by the second and third beat, holding at max chaos for as long as you leave it on screen. And Squachy's actually there now, for the first time -- flailing in a panic, sprinting up and down the margins (careful never to cover the actual readout), reacting again every time the glitch ramps up a notch so he stays freaked out the whole time, not just for a blink.

He's more alive everywhere else too. Arms used to just hang there outside of a wave or a startle -- now idle and bouncing both get a continuous sway, walking swings his arms with his legs, and he's picked up an original dance move (his own take on the "arms one way" family of moves, not a recreation of anything specific) that shows up sometimes when he's just standing around. HUNT MODE and the watch-alert screen both got their own reactions too -- a startled "there it is" the moment a hunted target's first signal comes in, warmer/colder callouts as you close in, and a proper freakout once you're standing on top of it.

Also in this release: LOG and the raw scanner share one continuous dimmed background now instead of two separately-scaled copies stacked with a visible seam between them, and a real bug fix -- long-pressing a row to watch/hunt something could leave the confirm panel accepting the same touch that opened it, occasionally firing whichever button happened to be underneath your finger. It now waits for a genuinely new tap.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: escalating glitch effects (text jitter, chromatic ghosting, TV static, full-screen tears) on the ALERT screen, ramping up automatically the longer a detection stays on screen
- **Added**: Squachy now appears on the ALERT screen, reacting and running the margins instead of being absent from the app's most important screen
- **Added**: an original dance move and continuous arm movement for idle/bounce/walk -- standing still no longer means frozen arms
- **Added**: HUNT MODE and watch-alert reactions (first-signal startle, warmer/colder callouts, on-target freakout)
- **Changed**: LOG and raw-scan now render one continuous dimmed background instead of two mismatched copies with a seam
- **Fixed**: long-pressing a row to watch/hunt could accept the same touch that opened the confirm panel, sometimes firing a button by accident
